title: Senior Manager Datacenter Engineering
description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Physical Infrastructure Engineering who is passionate about the electrical, mechanical, and controls engineering that keeps leading-edge AI/GPU infrastructure running reliably at scale.

As Senior Manager of Physical Infrastructure Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering team — electrical, mechanical, controls/automation, and infrastructure engineering and construction — responsible for the standards, specifications, and technical decisions that every new build, retrofit, and deployment across DigitalOcean's global footprint must meet. You are the technical authority for data center infrastructure: Design & Deployment executes floor layouts and installs against your team's standards; you own the standards themselves, the engineering judgment behind them, and the reliability outcomes that follow. This role reports directly to the VP of Data Center Operations & Engineering.

* Develop and own engineering standards and specifications for AI/GPU data centers, including liquid cooling (CDU sizing, secondary loop design, leak detection), power distribution, and controls/automation.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
**About the Position**

Cosmic Energy is an Irvine-based energy company specializing in solar, energy storage, and related electrical engineering projects.

We are seeking a motivated individual with an electrical engineering background to support electrical design, engineering drawing reviews, utility coordination, and project communication.

Recent graduates and current college students are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with electrical design and technical coordination for solar, energy storage, and related electrical engineering projects.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Review engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and technical requirements, and coordinate necessary revisions and updates.
* Communicate with utility companies to support interconnection applications, technical submissions, and related inquiries.
* Organize engineering documents and assist in tracking design, permitting, and construction-related activities.

* Background in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related field. Recent graduates and current college students are welcome.
* Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles and the ability to read electrical drawings.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD or other engineering design software is preferred.
* Knowledge of solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), electrical power systems, or utility interconnection is a plus.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* Good communication skills in both English and Chinese, with the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external parties.
* Detail-oriented, responsible, and eager to learn, with strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Flexible schedule

* Paid time off

title: Senior Manager, Data Centre Delivery
description:
**About Nscale**
----------------

Nscale is a vertically integrated AI cloud: we secure the power and land, design and build the data centers, run the GPU fleet, and provide the software that customers train and serve models on. Headquartered in London, we operate in 14 regions and serve hyperscalers, frontier AI labs and enterprises.

We sell through two lines. **Nscale Infrastructure** delivers large-scale dedicated AI compute to the world's biggest technology companies. **Nscale Cloud** gives customers the full AI lifecycle, from training to inference, under one contract. Our pipeline includes the Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, and the planned acquisition of Anyscale, the team behind Ray, adds workload orchestration to the platform.

Our customers choose us for delivery certainty. This role exists to protect that promise.

**The role**
------------

As Senior Construction Manager, you lead the on-site build of Nscale's AI data centers, from mobilization through construction, commissioning and handover to operations. You are Nscale's presence on site, accountable for safety, quality, schedule and cost.

Our campuses are high-density, liquid-cooled facilities built to house tens of thousands of GPUs, often on accelerated programs in remote, power-rich locations. You direct general contractors, MEP trade partners and equipment vendors so that each data hall is ready, energized and commissioned on the date our customers have contracted.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Provide senior-level oversight of the overall construction program on behalf of Nscale, directly supervising the General Construction Manager(s), Preconstruction Manager, Construction Scheduler, Cost Manager, and EHS Manager
* Serve as the primary escalation point for schedule, cost, quality, and safety issues that exceed site-level authority
